lines.text: Israel turned back toward the wilderness by way of the Red Sea and wandered many days around Mount Sinai.
The LORD told Israel to pass through Seir without provoking Esau's descendants and to pay silver for food and water.
The LORD said not to harass the Moabites, because He had given Ar to the descendants of Lot.
Israel crossed the Brook of Arnon, and the trip from Kadesh-barnea lasted until that generation of fighting men had died.
The LORD told Israel to cross the border of Moab at Ar and not to provoke the Ammonites.
